variants.name: Debrid Only

set excludedStreamTypes = ["usenet","stremio-usenet","p2p","http","live"]
remove presets[*].options.services
disable services[id=aiostreams]

variants.name: Nuvio P2P Instant

# Nuvio P2P Instant Variant. Inserts p2p-only scrapers, switches to "Tamtaro (Nuvio P2P Instant)" formatter, strips debrid/usenet/http services and addons, and disables seeder-specific filter & sorting.

disable excludedStreamExpressions[expression*="P2P Backup"]

variants.name: 1080P
Torbox Down
variants.script:
# Auto-activates whenever Torbox is down. This variant disables Torbox service in your base config and auto-switches to fallback services. Ignore if you do not have Torbox service.

disable services[id=torbox]
remove presets[*].options.services[="torbox"]
